meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后,当你想检查 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的安装情况时,Claude 会拉取最新源码做对比,输出带 PASS/WARN/FAIL 标记的健康报告,每条结论都附依据,并给出修复建议。它只做检查和对比,不会改动你的安装或配置。
howto.when: 当你说出“LazyCodex”、“lazycodex-ai”、“omo-codex”等关键词,或要求做医生或健康检查,或 Codex 在安装、更新或改配置后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的 LazyCodex 安装是否健康。
say.note: 会生成一份带 PASS/WARN/FAIL 的诊断报告。

say.text: 帮我对比本地 Codex 和最新源码有没有漂移。
say.note: 它会同步最新源码并逐项比对。

say.text: Codex 更新后行为异常,帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 会检查安装、配置和插件接线。

howto.what_en: Claude fetches latest sources, compares local LazyCodex/Codex install, and reports PASS/WARN/FAIL with evidence and fixes. It only diagnoses; never alters your setup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, asks for a doctor/health check, or reports Codex behaving oddly after install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
Compare my local Codex against the latest source for drift.
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources and checks item by item.

say_en.text: Codex acts oddly after an update—diagnose it.
say_en.note: Inspects install, config, and plugin wiring.
